title: Cosmic Candy E-Liquid 60ml (3000mg)
description:
Get ready to kick back with our brand new Cosmic Candy CBD E-Liquid. It’s got an 80% PG (Propylene Glycol) and 20% VG (Vegetable Glycerin) mix, making sure your vaping is smooth and spot on. Our Cosmic Candy flavour is all about bringing back those sweet memories with a bang – think Strawberry, Watermelon, and Bubblegum all rolled into one. It’s like a tasty trip down memory lane, giving you a perfect cloud with every vape.
Why not chill out and give your taste buds a treat with our blend of CBD liquid and classic flavours. Our Cosmic Candy CBD E-Liquid is here to make your relaxation time even better.
Ingredients:
Propylene Glycol (80%), Vegetable Glycerine (20%), Isolate CBD, Flavourings.
